title: Deterministic validation review knowledge
scope: Evidence boundaries for split, sealed holdout, bootstrap, metrics, costs, and validation publication.
guidance: Require exact split membership, availability, bootstrap commitments, and evidence partition identity.
Keep scientific ineligibility visible in complete results while integrity failures remain fail-closed.
Use the owner specifications for metrics, cost paths, evidence grades, confidence, and action constraints.
assumptions: Holdout access has already been authorized and recorded by the sealed-holdout boundary when applicable.
warnings: Validation evidence cannot issue final portfolio approval or relax sealed-holdout discipline.
